# BIG WEEK 2026 — Homecoming

> BIG WEEK is a four-night music festival in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, from 27 to 30 December 2026, celebrating Amapiano, Gqom, 3-Step, Afro-House and Afro-Tech. Theme: Homecoming — "Home is not a place. It's a feeling." Presented by G&G, The Goosebumps Company. Title partner: Flying Fish. Strictly 18+.

## Key facts
- Dates: 27, 28, 29 and 30 December 2026
- Doors: 15:00, festival closes 00:00 (midnight) each night
- Location: Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Venue to be announced.
- Age: 18+ only. Right of admission reserved.
- Tickets: sold only through Howler at https://bigweek.howler.co.za
- On sale: 8 October 2026 at 12:00 (pre-registered customers), 9 October 2026 at 12:00 (public)
- Contact: info@gandgpro.com, tables@gandgpro.com, 010 824 7639

## The four chapters
- 27 Dec — Yanoz Club (The Welcoming): the doors are open, welcome home. Amapiano.
- 28 Dec — BIG WEEK Presents Shimza: rooted here, heard everywhere. Afro-House, Afro-Tech.
- 29 Dec — Ak'lalwa Ekhaya (The Groove): different sounds, one story. Gqom, 3-Step, Afro-House, Afro-Tech.
- 30 Dec — Maziwe Ke (The Memory): let the moment be remembered. The finale.

## Tickets (prices in South African Rand, booking fee extra)
- The BIG Loyalty — R250. Returning BIG WEEK customers; general access to one night.
- The BIG Ticket — from R280. General access to one night of your choice.
- The BIG Stage — from R850. VIP stage access, VIP bar, VIP toilets, access behind the DJ; one night.
- The BIG Pass — from R1500 (loyalty from R1200). General access to all four nights plus VIP on one night of your choice.
- The BIG Table — 6 seater from R3500 pp (R21,000, incl. R11,000 bar tab); 8 seater from R3750 pp (R30,000, incl. R16,000 bar tab); 10 seater from R4000 pp (R40,000, incl. R20,000 bar tab). Every table includes VIP bar, VIP toilets, VIP stage access and waitered service.
